blocks.text: You can configure rules for a Privileged Remote Access (PRA) Portal with a portals policy. Portals policy rules allow you to delete uploaded files, upload inspected files, upload inspected Internet & SaaS Sandbox files, access uninspected files in the Privileged Remote Access (PRA) File Transfer System pages, and request and review privileged approvals on the My Approvals and My Requests pages. Portals policies allow users to access the Privileged Remote Access (PRA) File Transfer System and My Approvals pages in the PRA Portal they assign the rule to.
Portals policy rules include the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Manage the permissions that provide the ability to upload inspected files, access uninspected files, and request and manage privileged approvals.
Access the Privileged Remote Access (PRA) File Transfer System and My Approvals feature in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Control the file uploads and privileged approval requests for Privileged Remote Access (PRA).

blocks.text: If you want to configure portals policies, you must first create the privileged portals that you want to assign control to.
To learn more about PRA, see Understanding Privileged Remote Access. To set up PRA, see Step-by-Step Configuration Guide for Privileged Remote Access.
On the Portals Policy page (Zero Trust Browser > Privileged Remote Access > Portals Policy), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of applied filters available from the current and previous user sessions. Applied filters must be saved to the user session first before they can be viewed. Use the drop-down menu to select the applied filters to view. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Hide the filters on the page by clicking Hide Filters. Click Show Filters to display the filters.
Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Add a new portals policy rule.
View a list of all portals policy rules that were configured. For each rule, you can see:

Rule Order: The policy evaluation order number for the rule. ZPA applies policy rules based on the order they are listed here. Change the rule order by clicking on the number and manually entering a new value.
Name: The name of the rule. The description is also displayed here, if available.
Portal Configuration: The portal configuration you have set for that specific policy rule, with the following options enabled or disabled:
Delete File
Access Uninspected File
Upload Inspected Sandbox
Upload Inspected Scan
Request Approvals
Review Approvals
Copy an existing portals policy rule's criteria, and use it to create a new rule.
Edit an existing portals policy rule.
Delete a portals policy rule.
Depending on your Privileged Remote Access (PRA) subscriptions, you will see the following privileged policy options:
Consoles Policy
Privileged Credentials Policy

Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. You can also save applied filters to your preferences so that they're visible in future user sessions. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Expand all the displayed rows in the table to see more information about each policy rule.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
